turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on a, an and the?
turns.tutor:
Hi! I will do one first and think out loud.
She eats ___ apple. I say "apple". The first sound is "a", a vowel sound. So I choose "an". She eats an apple.
The rule: before a vowel sound, write "an"; before other sounds, write "a".
Right: I have a pen. Wrong: She eats a apple.
Now you. Write a or an:
She has ___ orange in her bag. (answer with only the missing word)
